subject: Post-call exec recap: Redwood + Zenovate — business outcomes & procurement path
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@zenovate.com>; Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@zenovate.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call exec recap: Redwood + Zenovate — business outcomes & procurement path

Hi Lisa / Tom — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our exec-sponsor call (Matt was pulled into urgent ops, so we captured the key items here):

Key business outcomes Zenovate is targeting:
- Reduce customer support average handle time by ~30% via generative summarization and suggested responses for Tier 1 agents.
- Improve lead-to-trial conversion on product pages by surfacing personalized FAQ/snippets (expected uplift ~10-15%).
- Maintain data residency for PII and ensure no training on customer data — required for Q1 pilots.

Primary pain points discussed:
- Current rule-based search is delivering low recall for intent-based queries.
- Latency spikes on existing embedding-based search causing poor UX.
- Procurement needs SOC 2 evidence and a clear SSO/KMS integration path.

Proposed scope (next steps / asks):
1) Pilot scope: 2-3 support queues (US region), embeddings + rerank + response suggestion. 3-week POC.
2) Technical next step: Aditya to share reference architecture and perf baseline by next Tue (10/13).
3) Procurement: Zenovate procurement to share standard SOW terms / required security docs. We attached a draft SOW and SOC2 summary for your review.
4) Executive sponsor ask: confirmation on procurement timeline — you mentioned an internal procurement window in Oct-Nov.

Risks & escalation items:
- If SOC2 evidence or key management requirements add >3 weeks, we should consider a limited-hosted pilot in Redwood Dedicated with customer-managed keys as an interim.
- API latency SLOs: we'll set a canary during pilot; if not met, automatic fallback to a smaller model to preserve throughput.

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_draft_v1.pdf, SOC2-Summary-Redwood.pdf

I'll follow up with Aditya's technical plan and a proposed timeline. Happy to jump on a short follow-up with your procurement lead if helpful.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0192

Date: 2026-10-05T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call exec recap: Redwood + Zenovate — business outcomes & procurement path

Thanks Marissa — really helpful summary. Quick answers and clarifications: 

- Procurement timeline: We are aiming to have vendors selected by the end of November. Procurement (procurement@zenovate.com) is on copy — they will need the SOW + security pack to start legal review.
- SOC 2: We can accept your SOC2 summary for initial review; procurement may request the full report under an NDA.
- KMS/SSO: We need to ensure key control for production keys (customer-managed). For the pilot, we may be able to use your Dedicated offering with CMK to avoid delays.

Next steps from our side: I'll introduce Sarah from procurement early next week (Mon or Tue). Tom will coordinate with our support leads to identify the 2-3 pilot queues and provide an example dataset (anonymized).

Appreciate the attach — will review and revert. Pleasure speaking with you — looking forward to Aditya's technical plan.

Best,
Lisa Chen
Director of Customer Experience | Zenovate
lisa.chen@zenovate.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@zenovate.com>; Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@zenovate.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T10:09:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call exec recap: Redwood + Zenovate — business outcomes & procurement path

Hi Lisa / Tom — following up with the technical plan and what we'll deliver for the 3-week POC. Attached is a short reference architecture and perf baseline steps (we included a lightweight benchmarking script).

POC deliverables:
- Integration: embeddings + rerank + response-suggestion API integration for 2 pilot queues.
- Metrics: latency p95 target < 350ms, average token cost estimate, and qualitative accuracy checks vs current baseline.
- Security: we can run the pilot on Redwood Dedicated with a customer-managed KMS for key control; SOC2 evidence attached for procurement.

Timeline (high level):
Week 0 (kickoff): share onboarding doc + API keys (sandbox);
Week 1: data ingest + embedding index;
Week 2: integrate reranking + response-suggestion, run smoke tests;
Week 3: perf tuning, measured results, and exec readout.

Open items for procurement/legal: specific indemnity/liability caps in SOW; Zenovate's standard redlines (please share). Laura — can you coordinate with legal on a connector for our SOW redlines?

If it helps, we can prepare a short one-page exec slide that summarizes expected ROI and rollback plan for procurement/finance.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com

Hi Sarah / procurement team — Laura here (Redwood legal/programs). Per Lisa's note, we've attached the draft SOW and our SOC2 summary for initial review. A few housekeeping notes to help speed review: 

- We are happy to execute an NDA if you need the full SOC 2 report — we typically share the full report under NDA.
- For KMS/keys: our Dedicated offering supports customer-managed keys (we can provide technical onboarding and a runbook).
- Liability/indemnity: our standard SOW includes industry-standard limits; we are open to discussing a procurement-friendly cap for pilots.

Action items (for procurement):
1) Please confirm the preferred SOW template and any standard redlines you require.
2) If you want the SOC2 under NDA, reply with your legal contact and we'll kick off the NDA.
3) Confirm a procurement POC approval window (tentative: Nov 1-15) so we can align resources.

I'll also share a one-page ROI slide before Friday to help internal stakeholders. Let me know if a quick 30-minute call with legal/procurement is useful — happy to set up.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
